neighbours.label: The words peculiar and quirk(y) (a peculiarity of character, a quirk of mechanics, quirky); other adjectives stay quiet
fire: There was a peculiar smell coming from the cellar.
It is just a quirk of the English spelling system.
Her quirky humour won over the whole class.
A strange peculiarity of the law allows this.
He has a peculiar way of holding his fork.
The film is a quirky comedy set in Iceland.
Every old car has its own quirks and habits.
It struck me as a rather peculiar question.
quiet: There was a pleasant smell coming from the kitchen.
It is just a part of the English school system.
